input.quote: Customer will comply with all international, federal, state and local laws, rules, and regulations of any governmental or regulating authority ("Law") that are applicable to its business and use of the Service.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no audit, inspection, verification or books-and-records right exercisable by Kubient against Customer (Impressions are measured by Kubient under its own definitions), and no right of access to Customer systems. Nothing to redline.

input.quote: Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement
input.rationale: There are no liquidated damages, penalties, shortfall payments or early-termination fees payable by Customer. Kubient's entitlement is limited to its share of revenue actually generated during the notice period, and the Section 14(d) prevailing-party fees provision is mutual, so no redline is required.

input.quote: (ii) the Service will perform in all material respects to industry standards;
input.rationale: Kubient's warranties in Section 9(b) are broad and run for the Term (performance to industry standards, freedom from errors materially affecting utility, security, no malicious code, compliance with Law, non-infringement) and the Section 13 disclaimer preserves them, but no remedy is specified for breach. We add our standard re-performance / repair-or-replace / refund remedy without limiting other remedies.

The Agreement contains no insurance requirement at all, although Kubient hosts the Auction Platform and collects, manages and stores visitor data on our behalf (Section 9(b)(iii)). We insert a short insurance paragraph in the General Provisions requiring CGL (USD 1M/2M), E&O (USD 2M) and cyber cover (USD 5M) with certificates on request; fallback is E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M.
